records.issue_text: save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] without checking the embeddable_host key exists; malformed requests raise missing-key errors rather than 400
records.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, the code directly dereferences nested keys `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without guarding that `params[:embeddable_host]` exists. If a request omits the `embeddable_host` key (or it is nil), this will raise (e.g., `NoMethodError` on `nil[:host]`) instead of returning a controlled 4xx response.

records.issue_text: cancel() in embeddable-host.js.es6 calls this.rollbackBuffer() but never resets categoryId, so re-editing a host after a canceled edit could show the previous unsaved category selection
records.rationale: While cancel() does not reset categoryId for existing hosts, re-entering edit mode goes through actions.edit(), which explicitly sets categoryId from host.category.id before setting editToggled=true. Therefore the previously unsaved categoryId value would be overwritten on re-edit, so the reported stale-category issue isn’t supported by the diff.
